name: Balasangham Kannur District Conference 2026
description: Representative delegate convention of elected student leaders from all 18+ Area Committees of Kannur, marking the historic homecoming to Balasangham's 1938 birthplace in Kalliasseri.

name: Sodarathwena Secular Children's Collectives
location: All Area Committee Centers across Kerala
description: Statewide secular gatherings organized on Sree Narayana Guru Samadhi Day uniting thousands of children through collaborative games, creative arts, and fraternity pledges.

name: Balasangham Pinarayi Area Conference 2026
description: Area delegate conference in Kannur district reviewing unit activities and electing delegates to the 2026 Kannur District Conference.

name: Bala Kalolsavam (Children's Arts Festival)
location: Unit, Area, District, and State venues
description: Democratic festival of non-commercial creative arts, music, dance, and literary expression celebrating collective joy rather than cut-throat commercial rivalry.

name: Balasangham Foundation Day & Flag Day
description: Statewide commemoration of the December 28, 1938 inception in Kalliasseri, marked by morning flag hoisting, singing the flag song, and reaffirming children's rights pledges.

name: Children's Rights Day (Baladhinam)
description: Vibrant children's rallies, cultural carnivals, and street pageantry demanding equitable public schooling and active safeguarding from child labor and exploitation.

name: Hiroshima & Nagasaki Anti-War Days
description: Universal peace vigils, origami crane displays, and anti-war street painting promoting universal brotherhood and nuclear disarmament.
